facts.business: Praxis Home Retail Limited operates brick-and-mortar stores under the HomeTown brand and an online portal, selling home furniture, home furnishings, kitchenware, décor, and related accessories, along with services like modular kitchen and home design.

auditor.name: Singhi & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company incurred a cash loss of Rs. 4,058.31 lakhs during the year ended March 31, 2026, has negative net worth, current liabilities exceed current assets by Rs. 5,994.33 lakhs, and received a notice under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 from an operational creditor. These conditions indicate a material uncertainty that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.

key_risks: Intense competition from organised retailers, online marketplaces and regional unorganised players
Economic uncertainty, inflation and consumer confidence impacting discretionary spending
Raw material cost inflation (wood, plywood, steel, fabrics, foam)
Supply chain disruptions due to geopolitical developments, transportation bottlenecks and logistics constraints
Rapidly changing consumer preferences requiring continuous product innovation
Regulatory changes in taxation, labour laws, environmental regulations
Material uncertainty related to going concern due to cash losses, negative net worth, current liabilities exceeding current assets, and notice under IBC from operational creditor
Significant expected credit loss on security deposit of Rs. 10,100 lakhs with Future Enterprises Limited (under CIRP)
facts.related_party_note: All transactions entered during the year with related parties are in compliance with Section 177 and 188 of the Act where applicable. Details of such Related Party Transactions have been disclosed in the Financial Statements as required under Ind AS 24, Related Party Disclosures. Other Income for FY 2025-26 includes write back of related parties balance and provisions of Rs. 2,693.72 lakhs (FY 2024-25).
